read: cover 44 & 45 (S13 & S14 Nardo, quantity 1+1): the drawing draws two covers of one shape, mirror images of each other (the far one seen from the front, the near one from behind): one pattern, cut once each way; built as the far one, the arm on the right seen from the front. Each corner was taken off the drawing's own lines (vector, isometric; every corner within 0.2 pt of a drawn line end): 260 x 80 cm, back 87 cm, a 25 cm back strip at 87 cm, at one end an arm block 25 cm wide at the full 87 cm over the whole depth (its top joined to the strip by a mitre line from the strip's corner to the back corner, as drawn), a seat sloping from the strip to the 42 cm front edge, 145 cm long, a ramp 55 cm along the front from 42 cm up to the arm (87 cm), and at the other end a 27 cm wall with the top rising over 35 cm to the strip (the back's top edge 225 cm, as written) and a hip triangle to the seat; the written 88.60 cm is that hip's edge from the 27 cm front corner to the strip's corner (sqrt(35^2+55^2+60^2) = 88.6). 4 air pockets for the two covers: 2 each, in the middle of the long wall and of the arm end. Rens (20 Oct 2026, question #116 b, his circles): 4 per cover, one in the middle of each wall (front, back, arm end, low end).
